name: council-dial-lite
description: The lighter, script-free edition of Council Dial. Runs a review council of Claude subagents the way you choose, with read-only agents by default. Claude saves each agent's report itself, copies the findings word for word into a summary that a fresh agent checks, and logs each run in your project. Claude does every step itself, so nothing checks the log mechanically; for research runs, use the full Council Dial: https://github.com/Ablation-Lab/council-dial.
